newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-FORMER ST ETIENNE CHAIRMAN ROCHER DIES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FORMER ST ETIENNE CHAIRMAN ROCHER DIES.

text.p: Roger Rocher, former chairman of St Etienne and a leading figure in French soccer in the 1970s, died on Saturday at the age of 77, hospital sources said.

Rocher took over St Etienne in the 1960s and turned them into one of the leading teams in Europe over the next decade, leading the Greens to the European Cup final in 1976 when they lost to Bayern Munich.
He left the club's presidency in 1982 in controversy when he was sentenced to four months in jail for operating an illegal slush fund.
